headline: Executive order calls for a plan to set up a United States sovereign wealth fund.
what_it_does: This order calls for a plan to create a sovereign wealth fund for the United States. A sovereign wealth fund is a government-owned investment fund that holds assets on behalf of the country. Based on its title, the order asks for a plan rather than creating the fund itself. No summary was provided, so details such as who writes the plan, deadlines, and how the fund would be paid for are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: Federal officials would be responsible for developing the plan for the fund.
